title: Samsung sets the date for the Galaxy S26 FE unveiling - it's coming next week
description: Samsung will introduce a new member of the Galaxy S26 family on Thursday next week (August 27) during its “Galaxy Event August 2026”, which will be livestreamed on Samsung.com and on its YouTube channel. Unfortunately, the company doesn’t offer any official details for the new FE. title: Amazon makes its Alexa+ AI chatbot free for eligible Fire TV devices
description: Back in February Amazon opened up its Alexa+ AI chatbot to everyone in the US, with Prime subscribers getting unlimited access to it for free. Today, the company is expanding the reach of the service, for free, to those who have a compatible Fire TV device. To clarify right from the start, if you have one of the following devices, you can use Alexa+ for free even without a Prime subscription: all current-generation Amazon Fire TV Sticks, the Fire TV Cube, Amazon Ember Smart TVs, and other smart TVs "by trusted brands with Alexa+ built-in" (including Hisense and Panasonic). title: Apple HomePad details revealed by macOS code
description: Apple's smart speaker with a display, which a lot of people have been calling HomePad, but which has also been referred to as Home Hub, is coming soon, apparently - later this year, in fact. The latest macOS 26.7 beta has basically confirmed the HomePad (not the name, though), and now a deeper dive into the code tells us that while the HomePad will run a variant of tvOS, it will behave more like a giant Apple Watch. title: Apple and the EU agree on new app store fees and new third-party app store rules
description: There has been a lot of back and forth, but Apple and the European Commission have finally settled on App Store rules that both sides agree on. Apple is now allowing apps to accept payments through third-party services and it has restructured the App Store fees. Developers in the EU can sign the new terms today and the changes will go into effect on October 1. Devs can choose to use the Apple In-App Purchase app, alternative payment processing or linking out to a website where the user can complete their purchase. Apps can also use a combination of these three options. Devs have to choose...

title: vivo Y31t launches with Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 SoC, 7,200 mAh battery
description: The vivo Y31t leaked a few days ago, and now the company has made it official without any fanfare, just a listing on its Indian website. The Y31t comes with a 6.75-inch LCD screen with 720x1608 resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate, and 1,250-nit peak brightness. It's powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 SoC. It has a 50MP rear camera with a 2MP depth sensor next to it, an 8MP selfie camera, and a 7,200 mAh battery with support for 44W fast charging. title: Redmi M100 goes official with a 7,900 mAh battery, Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 SoC
description: The Redmi M100 has become official in China, having been quietly listed on the Xiaomi website. The phone has a 6.9-inch LCD screen with a 720x1600 resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate, and 825-nit peak brightness. It's powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 SoC. It has a 13MP rear camera, a 5MP selfie camera, and a 7,900 mAh battery with support for 45W fast charging. The phone runs HyperOS 3. It measures 170.12 x 78.42 x 8.8 mm and weighs 232g. title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE's European Energy Label leaks
description: Samsung's upcoming Galaxy S26 FE has been leaking a lot lately, which makes us think that its launch is imminent. Today its European Energy Label has been leaked ahead of its publication in the official database, and it reveals an overall A rating for the device. Its battery life is rated at exactly 50h, its drop resistance is rated A, and its repairability is rated C. Its battery is rated to last at least 1,200 cycles before the capacity drops below 80%. description: According to a new report, Google wants to stop making any Pixel products in China next year. That includes smartphones, of course, but also smartwatches and earbuds. In recent years Google has been extending its production capacity in Vietnam and India to reduce its reliance on China, but a "significant" portion of Pixel products are still made in China. The 2027 timeline came from Google's successful development and production of Pixel phones in Vietnam this year. title: Spotify expands User Notes, adds Playlist Notes to its top editor-curated playlists
description: Last month, Spotify added new features like Running Mode and User Notes. Now the streamer is building on the latter idea with Playlist Notes. These will be used by Spotify’s global team of playlist editors to explain the thinking behind the given playlist – why was a song included in this particular list and what makes it culturally relevant? To get the answer to those questions, head to one of the big playlists and hit the Notes button at the top.
